From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Internal: Acme MSA/SLA redlines — compile positions ahead of 13:00 PT sync

Quick legal posture ahead of the sync — high level comments and suggested language. I'm attaching snippets below for paste into the MSA/Order Form.

1) Service Credits + Cap
- Suggested compromise: "Service Credits arising from a single month's aggregate SLA failures shall be capped at 15% of the fees invoiced for that month. The parties may agree in writing to a reduced cap (e.g., 10%) conditioned on a committed usage schedule set forth in the Order Form."

2) Uptime Measurement and Exclusions
- Add explicit exclusions: scheduled maintenance (with notice), factors outside Redwood's control (force majeure, customer misconfiguration, third-party infra outages). Sample wording: "Uptime is calculated based on successful request rate to production endpoints excluding scheduled maintenance windows, customer-configured throttles, and events outside Redwood's control."

3) Audit Logs + Data Retention
- Compromise: provide 18 months of audit logs for security/audit purposes; offer 24 months at an additional fee or as a terms addendum. Add: "Customer may request a certified export; Redwood will provide data export within 30 days of request for production data, subject to standard data protection controls."

4) Maintenance Windows
- Accept 72-hour notice for planned maintenance that is expected to impact >5% capacity. Add operational obligation to publish post-maintenance incident recap for impact >5%.

I will paste tracked-snippet options into the MSA and prepare a clean order form table with the 15% default and the optional 10% path for Marissa to present.

-Laura
General Counsel, Redwood Inference
